title: Purple Warrior Woman
description: A dark-skinned female warrior with short silver-white hair stands in a dynamic combat pose against a dark gray background. She wears a revealing outfit of purple fabric with white patterns, bone-like accents, and matching purple wraps on her forearms and lower legs, with visible white handprints on her thighs.
prompt: A powerful dark-skinned female fighter with short messy silver-white hair and intense expression, standing in a wide combat stance. She wears a revealing purple and white tribal outfit with bone accents, purple fabric wraps on arms and legs, white handprint tattoos on her thighs, and glowing purple energy effects around her shoulders. Dramatic studio lighting, dark gray background, highly detailed digital painting.
